title.en: An Act Converting the Rural Health Unit in the Municipality of Pilar, Camotes Island, Province of Cebu, Into A Five-bed Capacity Health Infirmary, To Be Known As the Pilar Health Infirmary, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trạm Y tế Nông thôn tại Đô thị Pilar, Tỉnh Camotes Island, Tỉnh Cebu thành Bệnh xá Pilar, và phân bổ kinh phí

text.en: The rural health unit in the Municipality of Pilar, Camotes Island, Province of Cebu, is hereby converted into a five-bed capacity health infirmary, to be known as the Pilar Health Infirmary.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
